source.sunriseDefinition: upper limb with refraction, no elevation (ADR 0012)
source.precision: minutes, rounded to nearest (inferred 2026-10-23 from sunrise/sunset errors)
notes: 2026-10-23: Drik rounds displayed times to the nearest minute, not truncation. Engine − Drik over Oct 2026: sunrise mean +7.6 s (−23…+33), sunset mean +2.1 s (−27…+29), about half negative.

2026-10-23: tithi ends show a real offset, not rounding: engine − Drik mean +62.2 s (+33…+93, none negative), i.e. engine elongation lags Drik's by ~0.5′. Still within ±2 min. Suspect lunar theory (astronomy-engine's Moon, ~±1′). To be checked in Phase 5 against an independent Moon ephemeris (e.g. JPL Horizons).

2026-10-23 (Phase 5): cause of the +62 s tithi offset is on the reference side. Engine vs JPL Horizons at these 32 instants: Sun −1.2″ (−1.7…−0.7), Moon +3.4″ (+1.5…+4.9), i.e. ≤ ~10 s. JPL's own elongation at Drik's displayed times is 36.6″ (18…56″) short of the boundary, so Drik's tithi ends are ~70 s earlier than the true crossings. Possibly ~30 s from Drik truncating tithi times (its sunrise times are rounded); the remaining ~40 s (~20″) is unexplained (candidate: aberration handling). Not calibrated away; tolerance stays ±2 min. See fixtures/horizons/ahmedabad-2026-10-tithi-ends.json.
